The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The pick of the drawn line, the New Pipe window and the new pipe object only meet in a live CD run.
not_automated: What becomes of the source polyline after Start Pipe (kept or replaced) is recorded, not judged: the card does not say.
